title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1010 | 百年新野猫、金字塔鳄鱼、太空皮卡丘
ending_game: Lina 的无厘头二选一：抱抱小野猫，还是骑在鳄鱼化石背上？你选哪个？

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hey everyone, welcome back! I'm Mia.

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: And I'm Lina! It's Saturday, October tenth!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: We've got three brand-new stories for you today! All super fresh!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Fresh like my socks? I changed them today!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Even fresher! Story one! Scientists found a brand-new wild cat!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A new cat?! Like my neighbor's cat?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: It LOOKS like a regular house cat! That's the funny part! People in Bolivia saw it for years and thought, oh, just a cute kitty!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Plot twist! It's NOT a kitty?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: It's a whole new species! Called the Tilkayo tiger cat! It has leopard spots! And get this, it's the first new wild cat found in one hundred years!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: One hundred years?! That's older than grandma!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha! Way older! It's tiny, with round ears. So cute! Can you believe it?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Can I have one? Please please please?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: It's wild, sweetie. But here's our word of the day: fossil. A fossil is what's left of an animal or plant from super long ago, turned into rock!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Like dinosaur bones?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Exactly! Say it with us, friends! Fossil!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Fossil!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: I love how you said that! Okay, story two! You know the Great Sphinx in Egypt? The giant lion with a human head?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: The one with no nose?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Yes! Well, scientists found a fossil INSIDE the rock the Sphinx is carved from!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Inside?! Was someone hiding it there?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: It was waiting there for forty-five million years! It's a brand-new species of ancient crocodile with a super long, skinny snout! They named it after Horus, an Egyptian god!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A crocodile god?! Does it wear a crown?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha ha! I love how you think! Maybe a tiny crown!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I knew it!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Okay, last story, and it's my favorite! A Pikachu toy spent sixty-seven days in space!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: WHAT?! Pikachu went to space?!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Yes! It floated around the International Space Station for sixty-seven days! I know, it's amazing!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Did it catch any space Pokémon?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Maybe! And now there's a Pokémon Space Trail at a museum in London, where kids learn about space with Pokémon!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I want to go! Can Pikachu be my teacher?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Best teacher ever! Okay, it's game time!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Ooh, my favorite! Would you rather... cuddle the tiny Tilkayo tiger cat, or ride on the back of the giant fossil crocodile?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hmm, tough one... I'd cuddle the kitty! Those round ears! What about you, friends? Ask your mom and dad too!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I'd ride the crocodile! Giddy-up, Horus!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! I love it! Amazing choice!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Thanks for hanging out with us! See you next time! Bye!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bye! I'm going to find a fossil!

vocab.def: what's left of an animal or plant from long ago, turned into rock
a group of animals or plants that are all the same kind
vocab.ex_en: a new species of wild cat

vocab.def: the nose and mouth part of an animal
to stay in the air or on water without falling down

title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1011 | 猎豹五胞胎、远古水獭、火星伴蜂巢
ending_game: 谜语时间：有斑点像豹、跑得比汽车快、会喵喵叫，但不是家猫——我是谁？

vocab.def: a baby animal, like a baby lion or bear
to put things on top of each other
what's left of an animal or plant from long ago, turned into rock
a group of the same things close together

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hey everyone, welcome back! I'm Mia.

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: And I'm Lina! It's Sunday, October eleventh!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: We've got three amazing stories for you today! Ready?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Ready ready ready! Go go go!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story one! Five baby cheetahs were just born!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Five?! That's a lot of babies!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: I know! At the Smithsonian Zoo! Their mom is named Zura, and it's her first time being a mom!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Is she doing a good job?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: She's doing great! The cubs are so tiny, they pile on top of each other to nap! And you can watch them on a live camera!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A cheetah channel?! I want to watch!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Me too! And here's our word of the day: cub. A cub is a baby animal, like a baby lion, a baby bear, or a baby cheetah!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: So I'm a human cub?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Human babies are just called babies, silly! But I like how you think! Say it with us, friends! Cub!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Cub!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Nailed it! Okay, story two! Scientists found a fossil of an animal that lived with the dinosaurs!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A dinosaur?!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Not quite! It was a mammal, like us! It lived one hundred sixty-five million years ago in China! It looked like a cross between an otter and a beaver!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: An otter-beaver?!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Yes! It swam with its front legs and steered with its flat tail! And get this, it could chew its food AND breathe at the same time!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I can do that! Watch! Nom nom nom!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha ha! Careful, don't choke! Okay, last story! Look up at the sky tonight!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Why? Is something falling?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Mars! The red planet is passing right through a group of stars called the Beehive Cluster!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bees in space?!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Not real bees! It's called the Beehive because the stars look like a swarm of bees! Mars will look like it's sitting right inside it!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Can I see it?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: If the sky is clear, look east before sunrise! Mars is the red one! Can you believe it?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I'm waking up early!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Okay, riddle time!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Ooh! I have spots like a leopard, but I'm not a leopard! I run faster than a car, but I'm not a car! I say meow, but I'm not your house cat! What am I?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hmm... a cheetah!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: You got it! You're so smart!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Thanks for hanging out with us! See you next time! Bye!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bye! I'm going to watch the cheetah cam!

title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1013 | 转圈小行星、长角海参、6岁魔方纪录
ending_game: 小挑战：像小行星一样转圈，一分钟你能转几圈？用英语数出来，再教家人今天的单词 trickster！

vocab.def: a person who loves to play tricks and jokes
to turn around and around very fast
vocab.ex_en: the asteroid spins every five minutes
vocab.ex_zh: 小行星每五分钟转一圈

vocab.def: a hard pointy part on some animals' heads
the best score anyone has ever done

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hey friends, welcome back! I'm Mia!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: And I'm Lina! It's Tuesday, October thirteenth!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: We have three brand new stories for you today! Are you ready?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Born ready! Bring them on!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story one! Two giant space rocks are spinning like crazy!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Like a merry go round?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Even faster! Each one is wider than twenty football fields, and it spins all the way around every five minutes!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Whoa! I would get so dizzy!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Tell me about it! Scientists just found them with a giant telescope in Chile! They spin so fast that they should break into pieces!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: So why do they not fall apart?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Because they are super strong solid rocks! The scientists were totally amazed!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Can I ride one to school?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha! You would fly right off! Spin, spin, spin, and you are gone!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story two! Scientists found fifty seven brand new animals deep in the ocean!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Fifty seven?! Do they all have names?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: One of them does! A sea cucumber with two little horns, nicknamed Loki!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Loki? Like the troublemaker god?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Exactly! That name is perfect for our word of the day later! Loki lives more than two thousand meters under the sea!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Does it play tricks on the fish down there?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Maybe it waves its little horns and says, look at me!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story three! A six year old girl solved a Rubik's Cube in about four seconds!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Four seconds?! I can't even find my socks in four seconds!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! I know, right?! Her name is lee-AHN yoon-JUH, from China! And she broke the women's world record! Twice!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Is she a robot?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha! No, she's a real kid! Just like you! A world record means nobody in the whole world has ever done it better!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I want a world record for eating noodles!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! That is a delicious dream! Maybe start with breakfast first!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Okay! Word of the day! Trickster! A trickster is someone who loves to play tricks and jokes! Like Loki the sea cucumber!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Or like me!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! You said it, not me! Trickster! Say it with us, friends!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Trickster!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Spot on! Say it one more time, super silly!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: TRICK-ster!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha ha! Perfect!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Okay! Tiny challenge time! Here is your mission!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A mission?! I love missions!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Spin like the super fast asteroids! See how many spins you can do in one minute! And count out loud in English! One! Two! Three!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: And teach someone the word trickster today!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! Yes! Teach your mom and dad! Ask them to spin with you! The whole family, spinning in circles!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Mom is going to get so dizzy!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha! That is the fun part!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: That's all for today! Thanks for listening, friends! See you next time! Bye!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bye! I'm off to spin!

title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1015 | 超级大南瓜、恐龙蘑菇、火星车纪录
ending_game: 二选一：骑在汽车一样大的南瓜上滚下山坡，还是开着机器人小车横穿火星？你选哪个？也问问爸爸妈妈！

vocab.def: to be how heavy something is
a living thing like a mushroom, but not a plant
a small robot car that explores new places

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hey friends, welcome back! I'm Mia!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: And I'm Lina! It's Thursday, October fifteenth!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Three gigantic stories! Ready?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Gigantic? Is that our word of the day?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ooh, sneaky! Maybe it is, maybe it is not! Keep listening!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story one! A gigantic pumpkin! Three thousand one hundred fifty six pounds!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Three thousand?! Heavier than my teacher's car!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Heavier than two whole cows! Ron Wallace grew it in Rhode Island! Weighed on October tenth!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Did it win?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: It smashed the world record! The first pumpkin ever over three thousand pounds! Funny part? One week earlier, a British man's pumpkin named Bagheera broke the record!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bagheera! Like the black panther!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Right?! But Ron's pumpkin was three hundred pounds heavier! Bye bye, Bagheera!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I want to live in it! A pumpkin house!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! With a pumpkin doorbell! Ding dong! Who is at the door?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story two! A mushroom taller than your school ruler!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Can you eat it?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Whoa, not this one! Scientists found it in the forests of Yunnan, China! Over fifty centimeters tall! Almost five pounds!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: As heavy as my cat!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Close! Its nickname is D-rex!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Like T-rex? A dinosaur mushroom?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Yes! Its real name is dee-ah-JOO-nus rex! Huge for a fungus! The mushroom king!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Did a dinosaur plant it?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Oh Lina, only you would ask that! It grew out of fallen wood! But get this! The biggest fungus ever in its giant family, with its own brand new family name!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: The king needs a royal family!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! All hail the mushroom king!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Story three! A robot car just set a record on Mars!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Who is driving it?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Nobody! NASA's Perseverance rover drives itself!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: A self driving car on another planet?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Totally! Forty five point two kilometers! The longest drive EVER on another world! Longer than all the Moon cars!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I want a Mars rock!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Oh, me too! Someday, maybe!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Word of the day! Remember Lina's sneaky question?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Gigantic!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Gigantic! Really, really, REALLY big! Say it with us, friends! Gigantic!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Gigantic!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: One more time! Like a giant monster! Gi-GAN-tic!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Gi-GAN-tic!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha ha! You sound like a true giant!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Would you rather time!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Ooh! My favorite game!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ride a gigantic pumpkin as big as a car down a hill? Or drive a robot car all the way across Mars?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: The pumpkin! I want the pumpkin house on wheels!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ooh, of course! Friends, which would YOU pick? Ask your mom and dad too!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: If you pick Mars, bring me back a rock!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: That's all for today! Thanks for listening, friends! Bye!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bye! I am off to find a mushroom king!
